**Best value on paper: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W solar panel kit** — listed at **$698** with a **1,024 Wh LiFePO₄ battery**, **1,800 W inverter**, and a comparatively large 400 W panel. That’s a useful combination for keeping essentials like phones, lights, a router, and some small appliances running. The catch: the listing says it’s a **preorder**, so it may not suit you if you need backup power right away. ([Listing and buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit); [details](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup))

**If you need one sooner:** consider the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W panel kit**, listed at **$729**. ([Listing and buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit))

Neither is a whole-house solution: think **selected essentials**, not electric heating, central air, or an entire home.
